content: EKReminder exposes parentReminder (macOS 14+) for one level of subtask nesting via public EventKit, confirmed by open iMCP issue #145 (feature request, unimplemented). Tags, sections, smart lists and richer subtask ordering have NO public EventKit or AppleScript surface at all -- only RemCTL's private ReminderKit integration reaches them, undocumented and version-fragile.
